name: Angkor
description: Angkor, near Siem Reap in northwest Cambodia, is the sprawling remains of the Khmer Empire's capitals, which thrived from the 9th to the 15th century. Across forest and farmland you can explore more than a thousand temples, from the vast moated Angkor Wat to the Bayon, whose towers are carved with enormous smiling faces. Researchers believe it was the largest pre-industrial city on Earth.
